svg.title: A gem line above the brow in five steps, light skin, eyes open. 1: mark the line with small dots of eye-safe paint or pencil, above the brow and down the temple. 2: place the biggest gem at the outer end. 3: gems along the line, getting smaller toward the inner brow. 4: one more gem just below the big one and tiny clear gems between the colored ones. Done: a few tiny clear gems and white sparkles. Nothing on the eyelid.
